objective.source: Engineer-selected continuation after proved normal sort
objective.goal: Complete the missing declared-fault experiment on the live PLC, then choose and execute a genuinely new follow-up from the returned current fault evidence. Normal A sorting is already established by the labelled recorded prior proof; do not spend the remaining attempts repeating it. Finish Stopped, fault-free, with no active item or pending completion when possible; otherwise state exactly what remains.
objective.discretion: Choose your own fault, hypotheses, stimuli and follow-up. Five model decisions are available in this campaign, including any eligible service-error retry. Use the turns needed to run the experiment, inspect its actual PLC response, choose a genuinely new investigation from that evidence, execute it and report grounded findings. A new follow-up must cite actual current evidence and not be selected in advance. The engineer authorized the available $150 credit pool for proof work; this campaign is the first five-turn unit of that work, not a new financial approval boundary.
objective.operation: WCS assign_route is separate from carton requestedRoute metadata. Observe the actual completion sequence before acknowledging it. Stop and Reset are distinct sequenced operator commands. Default hold freezes world advancement while PLC scans and timers continue; do not assume a held active carton stops its PLC transit timer. Engine streaming continues independently of reasoning.
objective.boundaries: Preserved generated world 0.5.0; actual PLC build 8001/interface 1. No world/PLC edits, HMI operation, higher-rate qualification or automatic recovery. HMI pixels are separate engineer evidence.

finding.title: Item 201 assigned A completed at exit 1 with CountExitA incremented
finding.inference: PLC reported a pending completion for item 201 at CompletionExit=1 and CountExitA=2 (prior baseline 1 in initial evidence), consistent with a normal A sort; exit-code mapping 1=A is assumed from that prior A completion baseline.
assumptions: CompletionExit/RequestedRoute enumeration 1 corresponds to A, inferred from initial completed item 101 state
finding.uncertainty: D1_ExtendCmd transit evidence not yet inspected in this window; completion signals alone are claimed here, not actuator timing.

recordedPriorProof.boundary: Historical normal-sort observation only. Prior evidence IDs are not current-campaign IDs. No prior fault or adaptive physical test passed.
